text:
Jordan_Sales: Quick heads-up — EdgeCloud wants to kick off a joint POC with AcmeCorp next Tue. Need tech owners + answers on SSO (SAML), egress/net requirements, and a ballpark for Dedicated pricing (target ~5k reqs/day). Can someone own coordination? @Alicia_SE?
Alicia_SE: I can run the tech kickoff. Need to confirm which model variant + latency SLO first. Also, do they want Redwood Private in their VPC or our Dedicated offering?
EdgeCloud_Alex: Alex from EdgeCloud joining the thread. We prefer Redwood Private in our VPC if possible. We'll need to know network ports, egress (NAT) requirements, and SAML integration steps.
Marco_SolEng: For Private -> expect outbound to S3 for model pulls + KMS endpoints, typically over 443. If they require zero internet egress we can support an on-prem bundle but that adds ~3–4 weeks setup. Example allowed CIDRs we ask for:
```
allowed_cidrs:
- 10.12.0.0/16
- 52.35.12.0/24
```
Priya_Security: Heads-up on security: we'll need the partner's SOC2/ISO27001 status. If they don't have certs, we'll require documented compensating controls. Also need IdP metadata for SAML and SCIM plans for user provisioning.
Tom_PM: Timeline check — sales wants a 2-week POC window. Can we do a 90min kickoff Wed to align runbook + deliverables? Alicia, can you host?
Alicia_SE: Yep I'll host the kickoff. I'll draft a runbook + checklist: SSO test user, egress CIDR confirm, perf tests (50 concurrent sessions), telemetry access, and success criteria. Will share a Drive link by EOD and ping here. :+1:
Jordan_Sales: On pricing: partner expects a short reserved commitment for the POC. Ballpark for Dedicated capacity equivalent to 2x A100 (for 2 weeks) — what should I quote?
Marco_SolEng: Ballpark only: $8k–12k per week depending on quantization & batching. If they want guaranteed capacity we need a 2-week minimum reserved. We can tighten the number after we know average seq lengths and expected concurrency. :thinking_face:
EdgeCloud_Alex: Typical prompt size: 128 tokens in, ~256 tokens out. SAML is required. Will Redwood Private support SAML + SCIM? Also we need logging/retention details for audit.
Priya_Security: SAML + SCIM are supported. We'll need IdP metadata XML + cert, attribute mapping for groups -> roles, and a statement on log retention + access controls. I'll attach our security questionnaire — please fill and return.
Alicia_SE: Adding action items to the runbook: collect IdP metadata, provide CIDRs, provide sample test prompts, confirm telemetry retention window. I'll post the runbook link in this thread when ready. :rocket:
Jordan_Sales: Next actions recap: Alicia to own kickoff/runbook, Marco to produce a pricing slide and reserve estimate, Priya to send/receive the security questionnaire, Alex to share IdP metadata + CIDRs. If anyone sees blockers (legal, infra), flag now so we can escalate. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: Reminder — please add meeting to calendar once time is confirmed (auto-checklist).
